Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery earlier — really helpful to understand FinBank's priority use cases around customer support triage and PCI-safe log redaction. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (high level)
- Primary use case: classify & redact PII in chat transcripts for escalations; integrate embeddings for search across ticket history.
- Expected QPS: 10-20 req/s peak for first phase; latency sensitivity for chat routing (target <200ms p95).
- Compliance needs: SOC 2 + in-region data residency for EU customers (flagged for later phases).

Proposed next step
- 30-minute product demo & technical deep dive to show runtime, quantization/sizing recommendations, and integration patterns with your infra.

Options — all times PT (please let me know which works or propose alternatives):
1) Mon, Mar 1 — 10:00-10:30 AM PT
2) Tue, Mar 2 — 2:00-2:30 PM PT
3) Wed, Mar 3 — 9:00-9:30 AM PT

Please confirm which option works and who from your side would join (engineering lead / security / product). I've CC'd Marissa (CS) and Aditya (solutions) who will run the technical portion.

Attachments: FinBank-discovery-recap.pdf, Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
